title: 2009 ICF Canoe Sprint World Championships
note: Dartmouth (Halifax), 13-16 Aug 2009. Races, lanes and start times from the ICF archive results book (each race header prints day + start to the minute, scheduled, HH:MM:00); race numbers from the book's own Race Schedule pages. TEAM = flag image identified through the book's own Countries legend (same image -> country name -> NOC), logged per boat. Full names from the canoeresults.eu printout (cfly.ca, approved for this event only, MAINTAINER_ANSWERS_2026-10-19c Q71) for the races it lists (finals A); elsewhere the book prints surnames only and seats bind only on a unique same-nation same-gender surname. Pre-2013: binds bound_by_name_unconfirmed (Q44). DIFFERENCE not written. Given names for 84 surname-only athletes and K1/C1 bibs from the canoe09.ca organiser draw of 11 Aug 2009 (MAINTAINER_ANSWERS_2026-10-30.md t86u ("For Halifax, yes, use the draw for names and bibs"); names and bibs only, never times). Crew BIB_BOAT holds the crew members' draw bibs joined with "/" in seat order (525 rows; MAINTAINER_ANSWERS_2026-10-30.md t86s490 ("Put all crew bibs joined with / in BIB_BOAT"; "the never-copy rule only covers vendor bibs that are ICF ids; real start bibs may go in BIB_BOAT")). t86s496 (2026-10-30 16:35 CET): t87 draw-mismatch proposals applied (keep 63, emptied 86, rebound 4); EGAN/HOGAN given names Jenny/Maggie from the draw. t88: crew BIB_BOAT now 603 rows. t86s503: given names Nivalter (36633) and Edward (36234) from the draw; t88 crew bibs confirmed.

bib_boat.detail: K1/C1/LTA single boats: BIB_BOAT = the athlete bib printed in the organiser draw (as printed, leading zeros kept), matched on event + nation with the book surname checked; semis/finals carry the heat bib only when the athlete prints one bib throughout the draw. Crew boats (K2/K4/C2/C4, relays, TA/LTA crews), per MAINTAINER_ANSWERS_2026-10-30.md t86s490 ("Put all crew bibs joined with / in BIB_BOAT"; "the never-copy rule only covers vendor bibs that are ICF ids; real start bibs may go in BIB_BOAT"): BIB_BOAT = every crew member's draw bib joined with "/" in ICF_ID1..n seat order, filled only when every printed seat matches exactly one athlete of the draw boat, every bound id agrees with that draw athlete, no seat is a late-swap keep (book athlete not in the draw boat; HOFF), (t88, per t86s496) seats of approved same-person keeps and the six spelling-variant rows count as matched, and no bib conflicts; later rounds carry the heat bibs only for the same printed crew. 603 crew rows filled (525 at t87, 78 at t88), 213 left empty (crew_not_filled). BIB_BOAT never holds an ICF id. Bibs are not lanes; STARTING_LANE stays as the book prints it.
